title: createPersister
subtitle: Create a persister instance
description: Create a persister instance for saving and restoring query cache data. Supports various storage backends like localStorage, sessionStorage, and custom storage implementations.

rows.name: type
rows.description: Storage type to use. 'local' for localStorage, 'session' for sessionStorage.

rows.name: config
rows.description: Optional configuration object with burstKey, prefix, and debounceTime.

rows.name: config.burstKey
rows.description: Version key to invalidate old cached data when breaking changes occur.

rows.name: config.prefix
rows.description: Prefix for storage keys to avoid conflicts with other applications.

rows.name: config.debounceTime
rows.description: Time in milliseconds to debounce save operations for performance.

returns.description: Persister instance with save, load, sync, and clear methods, or undefined if storage is not available

dos: Use appropriate storage backend for your use case
Set reasonable maxAge values to prevent stale data
Use custom serialization for complex data types
donts: Don't store sensitive data in localStorage
Don't set maxAge too high for frequently changing data
Don't forget to handle storage quota exceeded errors

callouts.title: Storage Backends
callouts.content: createPersister supports localStorage, sessionStorage, and custom storage implementations. Choose the right one for your use case.

callouts.title: Data Freshness
callouts.content: Be mindful of maxAge settings. Too high values can lead to stale data, while too low values reduce persistence benefits.
